mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production above 105 signals improving economic activity, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is above 105 and the economy is in early-cycle expansion, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 2.0% indicates rising inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime, simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals strong job creation, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS grows and UNRATE falls, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases during labor market tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (as measured by GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.
